verdict.rationale: Reflect documents a public API with OAuth2/PKCE authentication and specific supported actions (appending data to notes, listing bookmarked links), which is evidence of programmatic control beyond deep links. However, the API's scope is narrow (per reflect-docs-17 it 'supports appending data... and a few other things'), and no formal OpenAPI/swagger spec was found (reflect-probe-2 shows 404s), limiting verifiability and breadth for full agentic driving. Missing for 10: comprehensive endpoint documentation/OpenAPI spec, broader action coverage (e.g., search, note creation/editing beyond appending), and independent developer corroboration of API usage.
